name: Ribbon
summary: An app's command ribbon: a row of tabs over a card of labelled command groups, each with an optional launcher for its full settings. For a document, spreadsheet or drawing editor with many commands. Not for a few actions (use Toolbar), panels of content (use Tabs) or an app's identity (use TitleBar).
a11y: The tabs are the APG tabs pattern (Tabs); each group is `role="group"` named by its visible label, so a screen reader hears "Font, group" before its commands. The launcher is a named button ("Font settings"). The card scrolls sideways to its own edges when the groups don't fit, so no command is clipped or hidden.
